# Acme Storage: signed order form (customer copy)

Order AC-2026-0418, signed 18 April 2026 by both parties.

| Item | Unit price | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Standard storage | $0.021 per GB-month | list price, no discount |
| Egress | first 100 GB per month included, then $0.05 per GB | list price |
| Write requests (Standard) | $0.40 per million | list price |
